notes.title: Beta Test - We Have Not Forgotten
notes.content:
We hope you all are doing well in these trying times. We have not forgotten about everyone wanting to try Total Havoc. Total Havoc includes many modes and content you'll really enjoy. Full access to our playtest for anyone, anywhere to try. More details to follow. Check out our Weapon Animations preview video. [previewyoutube=KNf9x9UglUc;full][/previewyoutube]

Teleportation Concept Preview -
[previewyoutube=ECfkYqAqbUk;full][/previewyoutube]

Oasis Map- [previewyoutube=_dSVudA4It8;full][/previewyoutube]

Maps available on playtest launch date:
[list]
[*] Stranded
[*] Oasis
[/list]
Game Modes:
[list]
[*] Team Deathmatch
[*] Deathmatch
[*] Search & Destroy (Teleportation and second world disabled)
[/list]

All weapons will be available to progress and unlock content for. Ranking will also be available to progress as far as you can get. Keep in mind that we will reset the stats after the playtest, before final release.

Please share this post to anyone you'd like, and feel free to request access on our Steam store page!

Follow our Total Havoc Twitter account for all the latest information and upcoming news. https://twitter.com/VertexGamesLLC


Subscribe to our YouTube channel for the latest updates https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWb_JM8YCw2FLJ_gwWxxwYg
